method_training.artifact_inspection: Independently rehashed downloaded ZIP, CRC, native JUnit/log digest and source-scoped one-file patch; not separate native run nor external Git re-clone.

acquired.mutation: unescaped terminal regex $ -> strict Python end-of-string \\Z under same regex compile/match call
acquired.selector: filter exactly kind strict_terminal_anchor; minimum abs source bytes change then line; max32 candidates; no method changes after source exposure

comparators.description: frozen independent AST .match -> .fullmatch boundary matcher from predeclared grammar, without the acquired strict-terminal-anchor edit

first_native_failure_rule: Inspect futures in exact order, original base + head author test overlay; stop at first genuine source-native protected failure (no errors/skips) before method applicability; no source-result based future reselection.
claim_boundary: Even a cross-source success is only family-conditioned and depends on native/source-verifier assumptions; Lean/CLC/FLASH must actually check a declared finite transport and withdrawal/restart consequence before respective formal/incremental claims.
